## What's new

- **Themes**, as in PD2 Filter Forge: Preferences → Appearance.
  - Nine themes: DS1 Studio (the usual look), plus Filter Forge's Sanctuary, Midnight, Graphite, Nord, Ember, Verdant, Parchment and Snow (the last two are light).
  - **Make your own** from five colours (background, panels, text, accent, lines). The whole app previews live while you pick, and the in-between shades are worked out from them.
  - Edit, delete or share your themes as a code. The codes are the same as Filter Forge's, so a theme made in one works in the other.
  - **Accent colour:** pick a swatch or any colour.
  - The map itself stays on its dark background in every theme, like the game.
- **Linux AppImage, take two.** v0.2.38 dropped the main offender (libwayland-client), but the AppImage still carried other display libraries from the build machine: libwayland-egl/cursor/server, libxkbcommon and some libxcb. They're now left out too, so the AppImage uses your system's own display stack, as the .deb and .rpm do. Releases are now published only after the AppImage check passes.
